known.summary: The ancestor loop of `deletePath` stops only when a mapping holds more than one key. So a parent mapping that still holds one other key is removed together with that key. Pruning `statusLine.preset` then also deletes the user setting `statusLine.compactThinkingLevel`, which the doc comment of `deletePath` says must survive, and every sync loses such user settings from the deployed omp config.yml. The pull request adds ompRemovals.ts: the base has no such file and no retired-key prune.
